text:
arjun: quick kickoff — i'm going to 'slice-and-link' the big function-calling doc into three tiny anchorable examples so other READMEs can link to exact blocks. keep examples tiny and copyable.

mei: love the name. are we doing anchors per snippet or per code block?

arjun: per snippet. stable kebab ids: snippet-invoke, snippet-output-schema, snippet-parse-fallback. no generated hashes.

sophia: i'll add the snippet wrappers and copy button. plan to use the Snippet component: <Snippet lang=\"ts\" copy /> and <Snippet lang=\"py\" copy /> for python examples.

kyle: i'll author the minimal JSON schemas. rule-of-thumb: required props only, explicit types, keep schema under ~12 lines. also include one tiny shim example when tools return extras. e.g. tool payload:
```json
{
  \"id\": 42,
  \"result\": \"OK\",
  \"meta\": { \"duration_ms\": 120 }
}
```
and the schema will only expect id (integer) and result (string).

mei: we also need a 1-line parse-fallback sentence visible under the fallback snippet: \"fallback order: strict JSON -> tolerant JSON -> regex fallback\" and a tiny CLI test showing a strict parse fail then fallback success.

arjun: also call out SDK differences: label snippets for SDK 3.x vs 4.x invoke shapes. example text: \"SDK 3.x: client.invoke({ name: 'send_email', input })\" and \"SDK 4.x: client.tools.invoke('send_email', input)\" — label them clearly.

sophia: TS example i'll include in the snippet block:
```ts
const res = await client.invoke({
  name: 'summarize',
  input: { text: longText }
});
console.log(res.output);
```
wrapped with <Snippet lang=\"ts\" copy /> in the markdown.

kyle: for the schema snippet i'll include a minimal JSON Schema and one valid example output. also a 2-line suggested shim: `const { id, result } = response; // ignore meta` so engineers see how to handle extras.

bot-link: preview build: https://deploy-preview.redwood/docs/slice-and-link-invoke-4765 (CI: passed) :white_check_mark:

arjun: timeline — open small focused PRs by friday EOD. PR title prefix: `docs: slice-and-link invoke examples`. keep PRs scoped: one PR for anchors + split, one for snippet UI, one for schemas, one for fallback test.

mei: i'll open the split/anchors PR morning.

sophia: i'll ship the snippet UI PR today.

kyle: schema PR by thursday EOD with the shim example and short note on migration.

arjun: when you open PRs please add a one-line changelog entry for docs release notes and run the page link-checker. escalate if you find cross-page broken links.

sophia: tagging @arjun on my PR.

kyle: i'll include both 3.x and 4.x code labels in the schema PR where relevant.

arjun: thanks all — concise, copyable snippets only. ping me if anything needs trimming. :thumbsup:
